title: Prospective Mechanism-Mediation Decomposition, TT Survival/Replacement Hazard Instrumentation, Age-Coordinate Dose–Response, Ethereal Null Localization, Dynamic Collision-Graph Witness & Conditional Causal-Morphism Recovery

scope.support: same deterministic 128-cell P27 support rule reconstructed from the frozen P26 parent; no P28 outcome-driven reselection

mediator_contract.name: measurement-search TT reuse survival / replacement-pressure proxy
observed_coordinates: exact hit-rate sign under OFF->ON by dose
mediator_contract.estimand: history-conditioned change in measurement-search TT reuse after deterministic decoy-dose aging
mediator_contract.hazard_semantics: replacement pressure is operationalized as loss of reusable TT hits under increasing decoy dose; exact entry-level replacement events are not claimed
mediator_contract.no_threshold_rule: all mediator comparisons use exact integer cross-products of hits/probes; no learned or post-outcome numeric threshold

dose_response.history_template: target prime 20k -> d deterministic decoys each 20k -> target measurement 80k
dose_response.primary_signature: four-symbol OFF->ON hit-rate sign vector across doses, each symbol in {-1,0,+1}

conditional_morphism.law_endpoint: three-bit OFF->ON transition mask over curvature_class, dominant_coordinate, dominant_sign at dose=3
conditional_morphism.rule: pool donor state×square observations by frozen four-dose mediator signature; admit a signature only when both donor architectures contribute and every donor observation at that signature has the same law-transition mask
conditional_morphism.heldout_sequence: measure Ethereal SHAM-only mediator dose ladder -> seal conditional prediction -> execute Ethereal selective law modes
conditional_morphism.unresolved_rule: unseen or donor-inconsistent mediator signatures are UNRESOLVED
conditional_morphism.universal_gate: all 16 held-out state×square cells resolved and exactly matched

ethereal_null_localization.question: does the P27 0/16 law-fingerprint null arise upstream at the TT-reuse mediator or downstream of a nonzero mediator displacement?
ethereal_null_localization.criterion: exact zero/nonzero mediator-signature displacement and exact frozen law-fingerprint transition count; no effect-size threshold

collision_graph_witness.required_witness: dynamic full-key trace sufficient to construct the frozen-key collision multigraph under native and counterfactual index maps plus a bijective bucket relabeling preserving collision adjacency and occupancy opportunity
collision_graph_witness.p28_gate: HOLD unless full 64-bit key traces exist before indexing outcomes
collision_graph_witness.current_instrument_limitation: P27/P28 PSM telemetry exposes probe/hit counts but not full keys; hit-decay is insufficient for an exact collision-graph isomorphism witness
collision_graph_witness.forbidden: infer topology equivalence from aggregate hit rates or hashfull alone

portability_contract.reason: eliminate the P27 heterogeneous-runner ISA incident
portability_contract.binary_identity: all paired binaries SHA-256 sealed before selective outcomes

lawgen_v4.principle: mediation claims require an explicit observed mediator and a frozen mapping rule; operational hazard proxies must not be promoted to unobserved entry-level replacement facts

literature_constraints.constraint: mechanism transformations and causal mediation must keep low-level interventions, mediator variables, and high-level readouts explicitly separated

literature_constraints.constraint: intervention validity and downstream representational divergence are distinct

literature_constraints.source: Sutter et al. (NeurIPS 2025), nonlinear representation dilemma

prospective_claims.name: dose_response
prospective_claims.criterion: report exact OFF->ON TT-reuse sign at each of four decoy doses for every architecture×state×square cell

prospective_claims.name: ethereal_null_localization
prospective_claims.criterion: classify the held-out Ethereal null from exact mediator displacement and fresh selective law replication

prospective_claims.name: collision_graph_witness

claim_ceiling: The mediator is an operational TT-reuse survival / replacement-pressure proxy, not an exact per-entry replacement-event census.
P28 uses the inherited frozen 80k law readout and does not authorize transport to 40k/160k/300k.
A conditional held-out match supports only the frozen low-capacity mediator-signature rule, not a universal architecture ontology.
Ethereal null localization is limited to the observed TT-reuse mediator and frozen law fingerprint.
Aggregate hit telemetry cannot establish the dynamic collision-graph witness; indexing causality remains held if no full-key trace is available.
